subject: Feedback on the proposal
text:
Hi,

I've reviewed the latest proposal and think it's in good shape overall. I'd suggest adding a short section explaining the expected maintenance costs and clarifying the project timeline.

Other than that, I think we're ready to move forward.

Best,
Olivia
